user.title: Changan Qiyuan · Sign in
user.description: Enter the owner phone number. An SMS verification code will be sent.

code.title: SMS code
code.description: A code was sent to {phone}. Enter the 6-digit code.

pin.title: Control PIN (optional)
pin.description: The control PIN is the 6-digit security code used by the official app; it is required to send control commands. Leave empty to start read-only - you can add it later under Configure -> Options.

data.store_pin: Store the PIN (plain text in HA config)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The login session expired. Please verify your phone number again.

init.title: Changan Qiyuan · Options
init.description: Control commands require the PIN. The cloud also requires a one-off SMS authorisation: call services changan_qiyuan.send_control_sms then changan_qiyuan.authorize_control (authorisation lasts hours in our tests).
